content: Always consult your healthcare professional for guidance regarding this product and your specific health needs. Ensure you obtain complete and accurate information from your healthcare provider. Storage Instructions: Store the medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. If the medication bottle contains a desiccant, keep the desiccant inside the bottle. Always tightly close the bottle when not in use. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly dispose of the product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your use. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always seek complete information from your healthcare provider regarding this product and your specific health requirements. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this drug with others in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most current information, contact the applicable plan provider. When sending information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions to access the offer.
